verdict.rationale: Fern's 'Fern Agent' can be put on a schedule to review signals (reader feedback, unanswered Ask Fern questions, search queries, analytics) and automatically open a pull request when conditions match a prompt — a limited form of automated, condition-triggered action. However this is schedule-based rather than a general event-trigger/rule engine, and there's no evidence of user-defined webhooks, custom event types, or a broader automation/rules framework. Missing for 10: explicit webhook/event subscription system, ability to define arbitrary trigger conditions and actions beyond the fixed Fern Agent review/PR flow, independent confirmation of this automation working in practice.
